profile.name: Irfan Rahim Zabidi
profile.title: Software Engineer | Certified Data Analyst Associate

hero.content:
I'm a Software Engineer and Automation Developer at Toll Group, where I design, build, and support enterprise automation solutions that streamline business operations. My work spans Microsoft Power Platform, Python, SQL, REST APIs, and Azure, connecting systems such as CargoWise, ServiceNow, SharePoint, and Dataverse through XML and JSON integrations.

I take solutions from requirements gathering through to production, with a focus on clean, maintainable, and scalable engineering. I'm now extending that work into AI, intelligent document processing, and Generative AI to deliver smarter automation with measurable business impact.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics Engineering from the International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM).

siteProjects.title: AI Arrival Notice Processing
siteProjects.description: End-to-end automation that picks up carrier arrival notices from a shared mailbox, identifies them with a document classification agent, and extracts shipment details using Azure AI and AI Builder. Low-confidence results go to human-in-the-loop review, validated data is posted to CargoWise One as XML, and exceptions automatically raise ServiceNow incidents. I also own deployment coordination, failure monitoring and production support.

siteProjects.title: Air Event Milestone Automation
siteProjects.description: Multi-carrier flight tracking that collects milestone events from ten airline websites and converts them into CargoWise-ready records. Each airline has its own parser, including Shadow DOM handling, backed by status-code mapping, date normalisation, fuzzy port-code matching and data-quality flagging. Power Automate Desktop orchestrates the Python pipeline and SharePoint upload, and a cloud flow writes job orders and air details to Dataverse.

siteProjects.title: Sea Container Milestone Automation
siteProjects.description: Hybrid Power Automate Desktop and Python solution that tracks container milestones across ten ocean carriers, replacing unreliable legacy desktop flows. Designed for resilience: carriers run in parallel behind a circuit breaker with paced requests, and raw responses are archived for offline reprocessing. The reference carrier implementation matched 9 of 9 events against real shipment data.

siteProjects.title: Shared Mailbox Automation
siteProjects.description: Microsoft Graph automation for reading shared mailboxes, routing mail and managing folders, including folder discovery and resolving authorisation errors.

siteProjects.title: Azure AI Function App
siteProjects.description: Linux-hosted Python Azure Function App connected to Azure AI Foundry, deployed through Azure DevOps with VNet integration, private endpoints, DNS and access configuration.

siteProjects.title: Shopee Budget Optimizer
siteProjects.description: Personal project that adjusts Shopee ad budgets automatically based on ROAS, detects spending anomalies and sends Telegram alerts, with a web dashboard for monitoring. Runs on a VPS with SQLite storage.

siteProjects.title: Portfolio Automation
siteProjects.description: This website. A Telegram bot on my VPS turns plain-language messages into validated updates to the site content and commits them through the GitHub Contents API. GitHub Actions then rebuilds and deploys the site to GitHub Pages within minutes, and Git history doubles as the audit trail and rollback.

siteProjects.title: Projects Progress Dashboard
siteProjects.description: An application for managing tasks and projects, with features such as task creation, assignment, and progress tracking.

sections.heading: Enterprise Automation & AI
bullets: Design, build and support AI document processing that extracts shipment data from carrier arrival notices and posts it to CargoWise One, with human-in-the-loop validation and automatic ServiceNow incidents for exceptions.
Built multi-carrier milestone tracking across 10 airlines and 10 ocean carriers using Python and Power Automate Desktop, converting web data into CargoWise-ready records.
Developed a Power Apps exception solution that validates carrier data against CargoWise, redesigning updates into a stage-and-commit pattern with a single XML submission.
Automated customs declaration processing through CargoWise eAdaptor with XML validation and an audit workflow.

sections.heading: Integration, Platform & DevOps
bullets: Build and troubleshoot CargoWise One integrations using Native XML, the Universal API, eAdaptor and REST APIs.
Automate shared mailbox processing with Microsoft Graph and Power Automate.
Manage Power Platform ALM with managed solutions and Dev to Prod pipelines in Azure DevOps.
Deployed a Python Azure Function App connected to Azure AI Foundry, including VNet integration and private endpoints.
Build Power BI dashboards for operational and AI processing monitoring.
Gather business requirements and provide production support across all automation solutions.

Create a new project to improve operations by automating processes to reduce manpower and resources.
Create a user manual, specifications, a bill of materials, a standard operating procedure, and a handbook.
Overseeing performance, breakdown, and handle the situation immediately for first level support.
Operate and troubleshoot issues and follow up regularly to maintain system efficiency.
Guide and train end users on functionality, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting.

Simplifying processes improves efficiency in the development of AI projects.
Get feedback from end users to better improve the current system.
